text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On this day, we all came together to cheer on
Silence Suzuka in an exhibition race.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Haaah... My heart is pounding so fast~!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
*gasp*... *pant*...
I made it in time~!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Oh, you are...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Yes, Special Week reporting!
Has Suzuka-san come out yet!?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Haaah, what a relief...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Ah!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
And now, this Umamusume also graces the turf!
It's Silence Suzuka!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: ...Hello.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Suzuka-saaan! Suzuka-saaaan!!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Oh, my... Hehe.
Spe-chan came to see me too, I see.

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text:
"Suzuka! Do your best!!
Suzuka, go get 'em!!"

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Yes... So this is what 'have a safe trip' feels like.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And then, the race Silence Suzuka
was running in began.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: With an overwhelming run, she blazed past the front—

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
"...Thank you all so much
for your support today."

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to everyone's cheers,
I was able to take 1st place in the race.
Now, I'd like to express my gratitude through song—

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Suzuka-saaan!
Welcome baaack!

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text:
"Suzuka! Great job!
Welcome back! You worked so hard today!"

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Fufu... Everyone really was saying, "Welcome back."

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Besides, her expression is totally different from before the race.
She looks so genuinely happy—

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: ...What's gotten into me, I wonder?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
I want to return here again.
To this place where everyone is waiting for me.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
"No matter how far away I run,
with these legs, I surely, definitely want to return—"

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: ...Um, everyone.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
I'll come back in front of everyone again.
So...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
"Please look forward to our next live performance as well.
Let's get hyped together."

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Waaah, Suzuka-saaann...
Wait up pleaaase...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: ...Hmph.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Later on, while preparing for the Grand Live—

text_block_list.name: Uniformed Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Excuse me! Are you the ones behind the Grand Live Project that Suzuka-san is helping with?

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: Y-Yes! That's right!

text_block_list.name: Uniformed Umamusume B
text_block_list.text: Yay! Please let me join in too!

text_block_list.name: Uniformed Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
I get to stand on the same stage as Suzuka-san?
Does that mean we can sing the GⅠ songs together too?

text_block_list.name: Uniformed Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Is it really true that anyone can stand on stage and sing to convey their gratitude!?
I-I've never even held a microphone before...!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: It's true!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Let's all express our gratitude to the fans!
That's what the Grand Live is all about!

text_block_list.name: Uniformed Umamusume A & B
text_block_list.text: Whoa...!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Fufu, you're quite popular, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Oh? You played a part in that yourself, you know?
...Regardless.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"Suzuka. You showed a very
fascinating 'reaction' at that live performance."

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
In other words, something inside you sparked that change.
No, you grasped something yourself... didn't you?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: ...Yes. For me... no, for everyone, a live performance is surelyâ

text_block_list.name: Uniformed Umamusume C
text_block_list.text: Please stop!!

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
"...W-What's the matter?
Raising your voice like that..."

text_block_list.name: Uniformed Umamusume C
text_block_list.text:
Please stop already!
This Grand Live project is just...

text_block_list.name: Uniformed Umamusume C
text_block_list.text:
...So those are the girls
talking about the Grand Live?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "...That Umamusume was the one who had been watching the live performance earlier with an angry expression."

text_block_list.name: Uniformed Umamusume C
text_block_list.text: Saying we should all sing together... please stop...!

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: Wh-Why is that? This is a chance for everyone to express their gratitude to the fans...!

text_block_list.name: Uniformed Umamusume C
text_block_list.text:
"I don't want that!
A Winning Live is only truly a Live when you win!"

text_block_list.name: Uniformed Umamusume C
text_block_list.text:
"Because I truly want to stand at center stage and sing!
Even though everyone is cheering me on to do it...!"

text_block_list.name: Uniformed Umamusume C
text_block_list.text: Saying anyone can just sing along is wrong! Please don't disregard all our hard work!

text_block_list.name: Uniformed Umamusume C
text_block_list.text:
That just makes it look like an excuse using the fans
to run away from not being able to win...!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: That can't be...!

text_block_list.name: Uniformed Umamusume C
text_block_list.text:
Winners like you wouldn't understand!
Just leave us alone...!

text_block_list.name: Uniformed Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
...I-I'm sorry.
I'm... going home.

text_block_list.name: Uniformed Umamusume B
text_block_list.text: ...Um, me too. I'll go train.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
P-Please wait!
What about the matter we were discussing earlier...!

text_block_list.name: Uniformed Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
"...I'm sorry.
It was still too early for someone like me to take the stage."

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: "That's not true...! Your songs are too...!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A heavy silence fills the room.
We disbanded for the day right then and there.
